svg.text: SeedForge R3.1 core cell - system schematic (block level, budget power path)
Same net label = same conductor. Research-prototype wiring, not certified machinery safety. Generated by tools/build_schematic.py; pin map: hardware/wiring/WIRING.md.

The E-stop-switched rail (before the motor fuse) also feeds the Buck 12 -> 5 V = 5V_SERVO (PCA9685 V+). Pressing the E-stop de-energises motors and servos; the Uno senses the VMOT node through the divider on D8 (ESTOP_FB): no auxiliary contact needed.
Star ground: jack -, buck, Uno GND (and the optional XIAO GND) join one lever connector once (net GND). Uno powered from PC USB. All mounting hardware is M2.
Legend: red = actuator power, amber = servo rail, navy = ground, green = signal. Pin details and connector types: docs/electronics.md.
